summary: materialize(stream, to=...) — opt-in buffering utility that reads a streaming BinaryIO into memory (to='bytes') or a BytesIO (to='bytesio') to recover a known length. Used when downstream code requires a seekable or sized stream after transform application.
lifecycle_notes: Intentionally opt-in — streaming is the default; materialize only when length knowledge is required
documentation_hooks: Document when materialize() is needed: multipart uploads that require content-length, or pandas.read_csv() that needs a seekable stream
risks: Materializing large files will exhaust memory — callers must size appropriately

evidence.detail: Tests materialize with different to= modes
